g.aria-label: Telescoping L(x₀) via Bayes' Rule on q(x_k | x_k−1, x₀)
KL( q(x_T | x₀) ‖ p(x_T) ) where p(x_T) = N(0, I)
Measures how close terminal state x_T is to pure Gaussian noise
∑_k=2^T E_q[ KL( q(x_k−1 | x_k, x₀) ‖ p_θ ) ]
Compares each reverse step against Gaussian N(μ̃_k, β̃_k I)
Final decoding log-likelihood from lowest noise x₁ to clean x₀
Conditioning on x₀ makes every forward posterior q(x_k−1 | x_k, x₀) an exact Gaussian!
